title: Codex
current: All SessionStart sources run the hook, but the client skips any start without a transcript path before relay and registration. Saved forks retain their own session identity and start cache. Every registration path needs a saved transcript: the server never creates or revives a session row from a Codex hook without a transcript path, including lazy registration from tool-call hooks, so unsaved Desktop helper threads stay unregistered while their tool calls are still evaluated. Transcript and usage credentials honor CODEX_HOME. Project refresh renews changed hook trust. Desktop threads choose their own permission mode. Doctor reads the current turn before connecting and tells people to choose Full Access and retry in a new turn when the saved settings are already unattended. For a verified Full Access Doctor tool call, the native hook can start the stopped embedded database before it registers the turn and Doctor checks readiness. The recovery leaves writable_roots and network_access unchanged.
